scope: Current London Stadium in West Ham United football mode. Scope includes the mapped bowl and roof rings, compression truss, V-column facade, lower and upper stands, field, pitch surround, roof lights and fixed concourse.

references.caption: The London Stadium for Iron Maiden's "Run for your lives" tour
references.alt: The London Stadium for Iron Maiden's "Run for your lives" tour

originalReview.notes: The published creator-released panorama documents the roof underside, cable-net framing, inner transparent panels, triangular lighting paddles, seating bowl and the large display behind the stand. Temporary concert fixtures are outside scope.

The 2026 elevated view shows the uninterrupted white tubular compression truss, repeating white V-columns against the dark facade and concrete lower concourse. Angular claret, black, white and blue panel colors inform the palette.
The tighter 2026 view shows the roof truss depth and connections, outward-raked upper ring, dark gallery wall, decorative panel field and circular concourse edge.

quallaSearch.notes: Reviewed Qualla published images first, including the exact CC0 2025 panorama. The 2026 CC0 originals show the current roof ring and facade. Excluded unrelated sculptures, attribution-licensed works, copyrighted free-use files, Olympic-era roof forms and temporary concert equipment.
